package.description: Control media playback, volume, and videos remotely from another device.

en-US.description: Control media playback, volume, and videos remotely from another device.
en-US.longDescription: Media Remote turns a phone or tablet into a remote control for media playing on a Windows PC or Mac. Over a local network or Wi-Fi, it can control playback and volume, mute sound, switch to full screen, open video links, and start video or audio files from selected folders.
en-US.name: Media Remote
